newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 22.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 22.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 43.34 points at 6,660.21 after the market posted its biggest weekly gain ever last week.

* Indonesian State Secretary Murdiono said on Monday that President Suharto had expressed disappointment over Japan's proposed move to bring Jakarta's controversial national car programme to the World Trade Organisation (WTO).
* On Monday, the Jakarta composite index rose 4.67 points to close at 642.26 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,416.00/16.50 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,414.50/15.50.
* Conglomerate Astra following announcement of its audited 1996 financial results.
* Toll road operator Citra Marga on a newspaper report quoting finance director Tito Sulistyo as saying the firm expected its net profit to grow by 22 percent to 150 billion rupiah in 1997.
* Distribution firm Soedarpo on an announcement that state-owned financial firm PT Danareksa planned to acquire a 51 percent stake in Soedarpo.
